description: One run of the Docker lab (five scenarios) (lab/compose.yaml, scripts/lab.js): OpenSSH 10.0 and rsyslog on Debian 13, RFC 3339 timestamps. Lab clock set to about 10:00, so no login falls in the unusual-hour window.

incidents.notes: 10 wrong guesses (2 root, 8 deploy), the right password, then sudo useradd -G sudo sysupdate from the same session.
20 guesses at root and common service accounts, four connections at a time. Never logs in.

bob mistypes once, then logs in (low). dave's key login 2 s later from the same workstation is not reported: a key login after other users' failures from a shared IP is not a guessed password (this false positive was found by the lab in M1 and fixed in M2b). dave creates erin (low) and adds her to sudo (medium); bob joining docker is ignored.
One guess at each of ten real accounts. Ten failures in under a minute is a brute force too.

incidents.subject: user dave
incidents.notes: Two guesses at dave from each of five sources, none of which reaches the brute-force threshold.
